newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to launch a strips market in 1997 - Caruana.
newsitem.headline: Spain to launch a strips market in 1997 - Caruana.

text.p: Spain will launch a strips market in 1997, Spanish Treasury general director Jaime Caruana told Reuters in an interview recorded for Reuters Financial Television.
Caruana said the fiscal measures for the new market must still be worked out with the Finance Ministry.
"This project is very advanced, and we have only to define the fiscal treatment," Caruana said.
